remarks: Opportunities like this don't come along often. This beautifully updated 10th-floor apartment offers stunning eastern (ESE) exposure, filling the home with natural light and bright, sunny mornings. Enjoy coffee or unwind on the enclosed terrace while soaking in the sunshine and peaceful views.  The newly renovated white kitchen features stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a sleek, modern design that's both stylish and functional. Both bathrooms have been tastefully updated and feature attractive finishes that truly impress.  The spacious living room and dining area provide the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining guests. Generous closet space and additional storage make everyday living easy and convenient.  Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated, this home checks all the boxes. Come see it in person or schedule a virtual tour. Homes like this don't stay on the market for long-don't miss your chance!
